scope: Add direct AC1024 ASCII/Binary allocation-failure coverage for the profiled BLOCKLINEARPARAMETER writer, including caller-state and source-identity rollback, two-point property arrays, linear value ranges, and retry/readback.

change.testCoverage: The generated linear parameter has the full two-point prefix and nested property arrays, a distance name/description, explicit value bounds/increment, and three selectable values.
change.perEncoding: ASCII and Binary each exercise 14 allocation offsets. Every injected failure preserves caller fields and removes partial source-object identity. Fresh-writer retries read back the owner, points, ordered property state/code/name vectors, linear descriptions, bounds, declared count, values, and subclass.
change.existingAdapterControl: The existing dwg2dxf_dynamic_block_two_point_parameter_writer profile passes alongside the direct allocation control.

limitations: Fault injection covers the low-level record writer, not the enclosing whole-file output transaction.
A fresh writer is used after failure because the failed writer may retain partial stream bytes and a sticky error.
Generated transaction coverage does not establish physical producer breadth, recursive graph closure, or native constraint evaluation.
No DWG/DXF fixture is added and no support claim is promoted.
nextReadyPacket: Continue the P6 caller-state audit only where it closes another distinct writer gap; keep broad source and consumer qualification gates open.
